producer_report.summary: I trimmed repeated wording from the change verifier, study verifier and study producer prompt sets. Budgets stay at 1300. The change verifier went from 1298 to 1154, the study verifier from 1296 to 1195 and the study producer from 1257 to 1194. The five snapshot phrases stay verbatim in the shared verifier prompt, and the snapshot test passes. I added decision D166 and a CHANGELOG entry, and updated the two budget lines in system-facts.md. The budgets, athena-context lib, mirrors and policy tests pass; the full workspace test and clippy are left to Athena.
